Hi Sarah,

Great to hear — appreciate the timeline. Quick summary and attached line-item starter: Redwood can deliver the stack you described. High-level answers below; the attached workbook (Redwood_MediCore_Pricing_v1.xlsx) has line items you can drop into procurement.

1) KMS/HSM: optional add-on.
   - Managed KMS (Redwood-managed keys): $0.10 per 1k key ops + $2,500/mo for HSM-backed key container (recommended for high-assurance workloads).
   - BYOK (customer-managed keys via AWS KMS): no HSM seat fee, we support integration and pass-through.

2) Audit logs & retention:
   - Basic audit events (30 days): included.
   - Extended retention (90/365 days): $0.02 per GB-month for cold storage, plus $0.005 per query. We can also offer a fixed retention credit under a committed plan.

3) Data residency: we can guarantee hosting in us-east-1 via Private deployment or Dedicated pools. Incremental cost depends on capacity reservation: e.g., a 3x GPU dedicated pool + compliance bundle typically adds a fixed residency premium (see sheet).

Discounting & timeline:
- If Medicore commits to a 12-month Dedicated reservation (equivalent to our Standard Dedicated-3 tier) we can offer a bundled discount off listed prices (we typically run 10–20% depending on seat/commit).
- Private VPC onboarding lead time: ~4–6 weeks after contract + infra kick.

Next steps: 1) Review attached pricing workbook; 2) I can schedule a 30-min procurement call with Connor + Kar & your procurement this week; 3) If acceptable we’ll circulate a HIPAA addendum and SOW (draft attached).
